title.zh-CN: 全身水肿、紫红眼周疹与无力 · 4岁8月男孩
title.en: Generalised oedema, violaceous eyelids and weakness · boy aged 4 years 8 months

summary.zh-CN: 非凹陷性水肿伴明显肌无力和皮疹，需要超越肾病假设并识别严重肌炎风险。
summary.en: Non-pitting oedema with marked weakness and rash requires assessment beyond nephrosis and recognition of severe myositis risk.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 将肌力皮疹和肌酶与水肿病因对应。

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分培养发现与侵袭性感染。

text.zh-CN: 历史免疫和支持治疗后肌力短暂改善，感染反复，后腹痛进行加重并有红色膜状便。第55天大量消化道出血、昏迷并机械通气，次日死亡；未提供胃肠组织病理。
text.en: Strength briefly improved with historical immunotherapy/support, but infection recurred. Progressive pain and reddish membranous stool preceded massive GI bleeding and coma on day 55; death followed a day later despite ventilation. GI histology was unavailable.

prompt.zh-CN: 哪些证据反对仅按肾病综合征解释？
prompt.en: What argues against nephrotic syndrome as the sole explanation?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 明显肌无力、特征性皮疹和高CK支持炎性肌病方向
text.en: Marked weakness, characteristic rash and high CK support inflammatory myopathy

feedback.zh-CN: 水肿并非肾病特异，尿液和肌肉证据应比较。
feedback.en: Oedema is not specific for nephrosis; compare urine and muscle evidence.

text.zh-CN: 凡全身肿胀都应按肾病综合征处理
text.en: All generalised oedema is nephrotic syndrome

feedback.zh-CN: 缺少相应尿蛋白证据且肌肉异常突出。
feedback.en: Proteinuria evidence is lacking and myopathy is prominent.

text.zh-CN: 发热可以解释全部长期肌无力
text.en: Fever explains all prolonged weakness

feedback.zh-CN: 特征皮疹和肌病证据需要独立解释。
feedback.en: Rash and myopathic evidence need their own explanation.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 肌病理和临床支持JDM，感染与系统血管风险需同时评估
text.en: Histology and clinical features support JDM while infection and systemic vascular risks remain relevant

feedback.zh-CN: 病理用语和临床病型并非机械相同。
feedback.en: Histological wording and clinical subtype are not mechanically identical.

text.zh-CN: 念珠菌培养阳性即可证明侵袭性肺念珠菌病
text.en: A Candida culture alone proves invasive pulmonary candidiasis

feedback.zh-CN: 需要临床和组织等证据。
feedback.en: Clinical and tissue evidence are needed.

text.zh-CN: CK短期下降即可排除严重后续并发症
text.en: A short-term CK fall excludes serious later complications

feedback.zh-CN: 肌酶不代表全部器官血管风险。
feedback.en: Muscle enzymes do not represent every organ/vascular risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 严重肌炎和感染并存时，什么计划更安全？
prompt.en: What is safer with severe myositis and concurrent infection?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 风湿重症团队权衡免疫治疗和感染，主动评估吞咽、呼吸及新腹痛出血警讯
text.en: Rheumatology/critical-care teams should balance immunotherapy and infection and assess swallowing, respiration and new abdominal/bleeding warnings

feedback.zh-CN: 新腹痛不能只按普通胃炎处理。
feedback.en: New abdominal pain must not be dismissed as ordinary gastritis.

text.zh-CN: 腹痛只需抑酸，出现大出血再评估

feedback.zh-CN: 严重JDM可有危急胃肠受累，需提前升级。
feedback.en: Severe JDM may involve critical gastrointestinal disease requiring earlier escalation.

text.zh-CN: 忽略感染直接照搬多次激素冲击
text.en: Ignore infection and repeat historical steroid pulses

feedback.zh-CN: 必须个体化权衡病情和治疗风险。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：将肌力皮疹和肌酶与水肿病因对应。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：肌炎抗体、胃肠损伤组织证据、感染侵袭性及长期治疗可比资料。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Relate strength, rash and muscle enzymes to the cause of oedema. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Myositis antibodies, GI tissue evidence, invasive infection status and comparative treatment data. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 严重水肿性JDM伴致命消化道出血，机制未有组织确证，教学重点是早期风险识别。
conclusion.en: Severe oedematous JDM complicated by fatal GI bleeding without tissue confirmation of mechanism; teaching focuses on early risk recognition.

boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

testUtterances.text: 最先哪里肿，后来怎样扩展？
Where did swelling start, and how did it spread?
全身肿胀已经多久？
How long has widespread swelling been present?
走路什么时候开始不稳？
When did walking become unsteady?
现在还能像以前一样走路吗？
Can he still walk as before?
眼睛周围的紫红疹什么时候出现？
When did the purplish eyelid rash appear?
皮疹是在肿胀之后才出现吗？
Did the rash appear after the swelling?
声音有没有变哑，肌肉会痛吗？
Has the voice become hoarse, and are muscles painful?
肿胀时说话或活动有没有困难？
Has swelling affected voice or movement?
最近尿量有没有减少？
Has urine output fallen recently?
一天大概尿多少？
About how much urine is passed daily?
之前接受过什么治疗或药物？
What earlier medicines or treatments were given?
此前处理有没有改善症状？
Did previous treatment improve symptoms?
这次发热是什么时候出现的？
When did this new fever begin?
入院前发热持续了多久？
How long had fever lasted before admission?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
